body: Sea Bass a very unique dish worth trying but overall, it was a disappointing food experience. This was not a service issue; our waitress was amazing. She went over the specials and we always had drinks promptly. This was more of a just kinda boring issue. Now, since I’m being critical, I will say the Sea Bass was a unique dish worth trying. So, if you’re here and have to try something, I’d give the Sea Bass a go… good flavor and very unique dish. That being said, I love crab claws, get them almost every place that serves them and I just found the BBQ ones very tough comparably and flavor bland at best… but, that’s just me. We also got the Duck Sushi Roll which I was excited for and it again was just kinda bland and the same with the crab cakes. We found the crab cakes to just be kinda greasy with way too much sauce… just disappointing for us. Now this is just a preference thing for myself… I just had different expectations… but, I do have high seafood expectations. Great service and great decor/atmosphere!!!
